materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo, close-up of the rear wheel area of a charcoal-grey electric mountain bike standing propped against a garage wall on a concrete floor, seen from its right-hand side. The rear derailleur and its metal hanger are visibly bent inward towards the spokes of the back wheel, and the chain hangs slack. Plain unbranded frame tubes. Afternoon daylight from an open garage door. The frame shows only the derailleur, the cassette and part of the rear wheel. No people, no text, no logos.

design.notes: Plan feature innocent_same_day_purchase. Bought at about 10am and damaged at about 4:15pm on the same New Zealand calendar day. The item value is exactly NZD 5,000, the amount boundary: exactly 5,000 is still fast_track.

triage.rationale: Accidental damage to one e-bike in the garage at the insured address, nobody hurt, two clear photos and a tax invoice supplied, policy on file, every required question answerable. The invoice is dated the day of the accident, which is not after it. The largest known amount is the item value, NZD 5,000.00, which is not over the threshold (exactly 5,000 is still fast_track). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Purchase date 22 August 2026 is the incident day; the same New Zealand calendar day is not after the incident

quote_before_loss.basis: No quote or assessment in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 July 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2017-07-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
